bg: A wide 16:9 view inside a busy covered city market hall: a high glass-and-iron roof, rows of colourful food stalls with awnings, a dairy stall with cheese wheels and a white cool box on the left, a honey stall with jars, a big round hall clock on the back wall, a back door with a delivery sign on the right, warm afternoon light.

an older woman market manager named Mrs. Nakamura, Japanese, light skin, short grey hair, glasses on a chain, a green market apron over a cardigan, holding a clipboard with the stall list
a young adult man named Arjun, Indian, brown skin, short black hair, a white dairy apron and cap, rolled-up sleeves
a 9 year old boy named Rohan, Indian, brown skin, messy black hair, a yellow t-shirt with cheese crumbs on it, shorts
